system.description:
Reference Book: Star Wars Saga Edition Rebellion Era Campaign Guide

The Wing Guard serves as Cloud City's security force, provides all emergency services, and fulfills civil responsibilities such as those of the elite Storm Guard weather-prediction unit. Throughout most of the history of Cloud City, The Wing Guard is a corrupt force, reflecting the personality of the Baron Administrator.

When Lando Calrissian becomes the administrator of Cloud City, he clears out the corruption and turns The Wing Guard into a respectable organization. With better training and leadership, The Wing Guard becomes a reliable security force.

Wing Guard Patrol Droid CL 3 These Wing Guard Patrol Droids are designed to close to melee range with opponents and subdue them physically.
